# HelpText { #anylumino.HelpText }

```python
HelpText(text, *, variant='neutral', disabled=False, **kwargs)
```

Display contextual help or validation text.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type     | Description                           | Default     |
|----------|----------|---------------------------------------|-------------|
| text     | required | Visible text content.                 | _required_  |
| variant  | optional | Spectrum visual variant.              | `'neutral'` |
| disabled | optional | Whether user interaction is disabled. | `False`     |
